title: Welfare and Institutions Code, Division 9, Part 3, Chapter 2 (California Work Opportunity and Responsibility to Kids Act - CalWORKs)
verified_how: Fetched the WIC Div 9 Part 3 expanded branch: 'CHAPTER 2. California Work Opportunity and Responsibility to Kids Act 11200-11526.5'. §11200 says it may be cited as that Act and as the CalWORKs program.
notes: Cash aid to needy families. Medi-Cal is in Ch 7 of the same Part (14000-14199.97). State supplementary SSI/SSP is Ch 3 (12000-12351).
